jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Platform
jobs.content:
Acme Corp (Fictitious) is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Platform team. You will design and build the distributed infrastructure that powers our product.

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Strong Python and Go skills
  • Experience with distributed systems
  • PostgreSQL, Redis, or similar databases

Nice to have: Kubernetes, AWS, Terraform

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.content:
We are hiring a Staff Engineer for our Infrastructure team. This is a fully remote role.

  • 8+ years of experience
  • Deep expertise in Kubernetes and container orchestration
  • Experience with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code
  • AWS or GCP cloud platforms

jobs.title: Backend Engineer (Python)
jobs.content:
Join our growing engineering team. You will build APIs and backend services for our core product.

  • 3+ years backend engineering experience
  • Python proficiency required
  • FastAPI or Django experience a plus
  • Experience with async Python
